summary: Electra Battery Materials filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 16, 2026 press release announcing preliminary FEL-1 engineering results for a proposed two-phase nickel refinery, with a first phase targeting approximately 20,000 tonnes per year of contained nickel from mine-derived feedstock and recycled battery black mass. No transaction, price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation or closing date is stated; no capital, ownership or regulatory mechanics arise. This is an ordinary operational/technical update, not a special situation, so no deal terms attach. What to watch: future financing and permitting announcements, not risk arbitrage.
